claim_text: SPRED1 pathogenic variants account for about 1% of sporadic and 19% of familial cases presenting with only the pigmentary features of NF1 (cafe-au-lait macules and freckling).
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): Messiaen et al. (ref 14). Primary paper should be read directly and may support a higher strength.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
